cards.ex: I'm always on the go these days, juggling work and family.
cards.exUz: Men hozirgi kunda doimiy harakatdaman, ish va oilani muvozanatlashtiraman.
cards.uzDef: Doimiy harakatda bo'lish, tinimsiz ishlash yoki sayohat qilish.

cards.ex: It goes without saying that punctuality is important in this job.
cards.exUz: Bu ishda aniqlik muhim ekani o'z-o'zidan ravshan.
cards.uzDef: Bu o'z-o'zidan ma'lum, buni aytishga ham hojat yo'q.

cards.ex: We go out for dinner now and then, but mostly we eat at home.
cards.exUz: Biz vaqti-vaqti bilan kechki ovqatga chiqamiz, lekin asosan uyda ovqatlanamiz.
cards.uzDef: Ba'zan, juda tez-tez emas.

cards.ex: It's tough, but we manage to get by on a single income.
cards.exUz: Qiyin, lekin biz bir daromad bilan kun kechirishga harakat qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yetarli resurslar bilan qiyinchilik bilan yashash.

cards.ex: We don't have much money, so we have to make do with what we have.
cards.exUz: Bizda uncha ko'p pul yo'q, shuning uchun boriga qanoat qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Mavjud bo'lgan narsa bilan kifoyalanish.

cards.ex: There are some exciting new projects on the horizon for our company.
cards.exUz: Kompaniyamiz uchun ufukda bir nechta qiziqarli yangi loyihalar mavjud.
cards.uzDef: Ya]in kelajakda sodir bo'lishi kutilayotgan narsa.

cards.ex: She always goes the extra mile to help her students succeed.
cards.exUz: U doimo o'z talabalariga muvaffaqiyat qozonishda yordam berish uchun jon kuydiradi.
cards.uzDef: Oddiydan ortiq harakat qilmoq, ko'proq ish qilmoq.

cards.ex: The decline of traditional media is a sign of the times.
cards.exUz: An'anaviy ommaviy axborot vositalarining pasayishi zamon alomatidir.
cards.uzDef: Hozirgi zamonning xususiyatli belgisi.

cards.ex: You have a point, but I still disagree with your conclusion.
cards.exUz: Sizning haqligingiz bor, lekin men hali ham xulosangizga qo'shilmayman.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri fikrga ega bo'lish, mantiqiy asosga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with all the new technology these days.
cards.exUz: Hozirgi kunda barcha yangi texnologiyalar bilan birga bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Bilan bir xil darajada rivojlanib bormoq.

cards.ex: I try to stay on top of the latest news in my field.
cards.exUz: Men sohamdagi so'nggi yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lishga harakat qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Holatni nazoratda ushlab turmoq, yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: We need to take his experience into account when making this decision.
cards.exUz: Biz bu qarorni qabul qilishda uning tajribasini hisobga olishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida o'ylash yoki nimadirni e'tiborga olmoq.

cards.ex: First and foremost, we need to ensure everyone's safety.
cards.exUz: Avvalo, biz hammamizning xavfsizligimizni ta'minlashimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Eng muhimi, birinchi navbatda.

cards.ex: It all comes down to whether we have enough funding.
cards.exUz: Bularning barchasi bizda yetarli mablag 'bor-yo'qligiga bog'liq.
cards.uzDef: Oxir-oqibatda nimagadir bog'liq bo'lish.

cards.ex: The project is more or less finished; we just need to do some final touches.
cards.exUz: Loyiha deyarli tugallangan; biz faqat so'nggi teginishlarni qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Taxminan, aniq emas, lekin yaqin.

cards.ex: I do the same routine day in, day out. It's so boring!
cards.exUz: Men kun sayin bir xil tartibni bajaraman. Bu juda zerikarli!
cards.uzDef: Har kuni, doimo takrorlanuvchi.

cards.ex: I need to get up to speed on the new project before the meeting.
cards.exUz: Yig'ilishdan oldin yangi loyiha haqida xabardor bo'lishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ma'lumot yoki vaziyat haqida xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: We're on track to finish the project by the deadline.
cards.exUz: Biz loyihani belgilangan muddatga tugatish yo'lida turibmiz.
cards.uzDef: Reja bo'yicha ketayotgan, maqsadga erishish yo'lida.

cards.ex: It remains to be seen whether the new policy will be successful.
cards.exUz: Yangi siyosat muvaffaqiyatli bo'ladimi, yo'qmi - hali ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda nima bo'lishi noma'lum.

cards.ex: Investing in education is beneficial in the long run.
cards.exUz: Ta'limga sarmoya kiritish uzoq muddatda foydali.
cards.uzDef: Kelajakda, uzoq vaqt o'tgach.

cards.ex: Let's cut to the chase: are you willing to accept the offer?
cards.exUz: Keling, asosiy mavzuga o'taylik: taklifni qabul qilishga tayyormisiz?
cards.uzDef: Ortiqcha gaplarni tashlab, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri asosiy narsaga o'tish.

cards.ex: Let's get the ball rolling on this project by assigning tasks.
cards.exUz: Keling, vazifalarni belgilash orqali ushbu loyihani boshlaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani boshlash, harakatga keltirish.

cards.ex: We have several new products in the pipeline that we're excited about.
cards.exUz: Bizda bir nechta yangi mahsulotlar tayyorlanmoqda, biz bundan juda xursandmiz.
cards.uzDef: Rivojlanish jarayonida bo'lish, tayyorlanayotgan bo'lish.

cards.ex: It takes time to get a handle on all the new software.
cards.exUz: Barcha yangi dasturlarni o'rganib olish vaqt talab etadi.
cards.uzDef: Tushunishni boshlash, ustidan chiqish, nazoratga olish.

cards.ex: Experience comes into play when dealing with complex problems.
cards.exUz: Murakkab muammolarni hal qilishda tajriba muhim rol o'ynaydi.
cards.uzDef: Muhim rol o'ynamoq, ta'sir ko'rsatmoq.

cards.ex: My language skills are still a work in progress, but I'm improving.
cards.exUz: Mening til ko'nikmalarim hali ham ish jarayonida, lekin men yaxshilanmoqdaman.
cards.term: to be a work in progress
cards.uzDef: Hali tugallanmagan, rivojlanishda davom etayotgan.

cards.ex: At this rate, we'll never finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Agar shu sur'atda davom etsak, loyihani hech qachon vaqtida tugatmaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Agar hozirgi sur'at saqlanib qolsa.

cards.ex: It took me a while, but I'm finally getting the hang of driving a manual car.
cards.exUz: Menga biroz vaqt kerak bo'ldi, lekin men nihoyat qo'lda boshqariladigan mashinani haydashni o'rganyapman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani qanday qilishni o'rganish, ustasini topish.

cards.ex: We've only just started, but so far so good. No major issues.
cards.exUz: Biz endigina boshladik, lekin hozircha hammasi yaxshi. Hech qanday jiddiy muammo yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Hozirga qadar muammosiz, hammasi yaxshi.

cards.ex: Before we start, let's make sure we're all on the same page about the goals.
cards.exUz: Boshlashdan oldin, maqsadlar bo'yicha hammamiz bir xil fikrda ekanligimizga ishonch hosil qilaylik.
cards.term: to be on the same page
cards.uzDef: Bir xil fikrga ega bo'lish, bir-birini tushunish.
